title: Autograder Flow Map
subtitle: How an exam becomes a grade — runtime flows verified in source

groups.name: Entry
groups.summary: How work starts: terminal, browser, batch

groups.name: Intake & key
groups.summary: Pages in; answer key parsed, repaired, cached

groups.name: Extraction
groups.summary: What the student marked and wrote

groups.name: Model access
groups.summary: One guarded road to every model

components.name: CLI (autograder ...)
components.summary: Console entry: grade, parse-key, run-job, ui, doctor, readiness, bench, eval-batch. run_grade_pipeline (cli.py:553) is the single end-to-end driver used by both grade and eval-batch. Direct cloud backends are refused up front (guard_direct_cloud_backend).

components.name: Web UI (Streamlit)
components.summary: Six screens: dashboard, exam setup, grading progress, review queue, results, advanced. Observes the detached runner only via its PID and on-disk state.

components.name: Batch job runner
components.summary: Runs a job dir: one `autograder grade` subprocess per exam, scrapes child stdout into state.json stage updates, honors stop/pause sentinel files (can kill a hung model call), combines outputs at batch end.

components.name: Benchmark & eval harness
components.summary: `autograder bench ...`: frozen-manifest model-selection campaigns with their own gateway, cache, ledger and campaign-wide budget ceiling. Reuses the production prompt builders and decoding knobs. Held-out evaluation is a separately confirmed path; --research is the only cloud-boundary bypass.

components.name: Ingest & masking
components.summary: PDF/images become page images (plus text layer). Red instructor ink is masked out before any model sees a page; masking.json records what was removed.

components.name: Answer key service
components.summary: Model-parses the key PDF, then deterministic acceptance (flattened-version-columns detector), text-layer repair of per-version letters, operator overrides. Only validated keys reach the persistent key cache; rejected parses are preserved for diagnosis.

components.name: Survey, variant & alignment
components.summary: Low-res whole-doc survey + high-res close-read of just the sheet pages; cover-marker version detection; printed-to-key alignment where an operator override wins, model-derived mappings stay review-flagged, and identity is the fallback.

components.name: Extraction & answer tables
components.summary: Deterministic per-cell ink analysis is the production MC reader; per-row VLM is only a fallback. Answer-sheet authority: question-page scratch never overrides a usable sheet. In reliability mode explanation transcriptions are structurally deferred (stripped, not prompted away).

components.name: MC resolver chain
components.summary: Dependency-injected resolver for multi-mark rows: crop triage, then a local model. The cloud step exists but is off by default — and the production boundary would refuse it anyway. Unresolved rows become review items, never guesses.

components.name: Reliability route
components.summary: Per-sub-item decision machine: policy gate before any spend, lazy OCR only once the gate proves it is needed, escalation on suspicion, typed REVIEW/PAUSED outcomes, decision trace appended as it runs. Gateway-only — it never touches a backend directly.

components.name: Legacy judge & scoring
components.summary: judge_all: one judge model call per question (legacy and shadow modes). grade_exam: deterministic scoring, caps and review flags; the arithmetic invariant check inserts a review item rather than silently correcting a total.

components.name: Escalation & verification
components.summary: OCR verify: independent verifier, 0.95 agreement floor, fail-closed without an evidence crop — and the production crop provider is deliberately unavailable. Grade path: primary grade, validate, optional RAG retry, escalation grader; unresolved disagreement goes to review.

components.name: Grading packs, RAG & preflight
components.summary: Per-question grading packs built once per package and reused for every student. Local course RAG (Ollama embeddings). Package discovery plus the single preflight gate that stops a batch on structural defects before they become N identical review items.

components.name: Results & review queue
components.summary: result.json + report.md, then a review queue with 14 typed reason codes in 5 priority tiers. Grouping is mechanical-fingerprint only (semantically similar answers are never grouped); batch anomalies surface before per-item review; per-item decision traces explain every grade.

components.name: Instructor / reviewer
components.summary: Resolves queued cases in the web UI. Apply-to-all is allowed only for variant/layout decisions — semantic grades raise an error — and every broadcast is audited.

components.name: Job & exam artifacts
components.summary: jobs/<id>: job.json, state.json (atomic per transition), anonymized uploads (real names never reach a model), per-exam out dirs (answer_key, survey, alignment, extraction, decisions.jsonl, result.json, report.md, resume fingerprints), grade.log, combined results.

components.name: Orchestrator runtime
components.summary: The single Runtime constructor (setup_from_config): gateway + request cache + usage ledger + budget, all from models.toml. Installs the DI hooks that give the validated pipeline its model access; model failures write model_failures.jsonl and a pause.request.

components.name: Model gateway
components.summary: Every call, in order: cloud boundary (remote = approved OCR prompts with clean payloads, nothing else), privacy scan (hard identifiers abort), request cache, budget check, provider call, accounting. Failures are ledgered too — the money is already spent.

components.name: Caches, ledger & spend
components.summary: Content-addressed request cache (failures never stored), JSONL usage ledger (one row per provider response, secrets stripped), budget soft-warn/hard-pause, and read-only spend reports kept strictly separate from forward estimates.

components.name: Vision backends
components.summary: The only backend selection site (create_backend): OpenAI-compat, native Ollama, OpenRouter, optional Anthropic, and a recording mock for offline tests. Legacy stages call VisionBackend.parse directly (local/mock enforced); gateway routes arrive here lazily and memoised.

components.name: Local models
components.summary: Ollama (native /api/chat) and any OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp...). All grading-content model work stays here in production. Also serves the local RAG embeddings.

components.name: Cloud LLM APIs
components.summary: OpenRouter (key from env only, usage/cost captured; optional Anthropic extra for doctor/dev comparisons). In production the boundary admits only approved OCR transcription prompts whose payloads carry no grading context.

flows.label: autograder ui
flows.summary: cmd_ui launches Streamlit on webui.py in a child process.

flows.label: spawn run-job (detached)
flows.summary: Popen `python -m autograder run-job --job-dir <job>`, DETACHED_PROCESS on Windows; PID written to runner.pid. The UI can close and the batch keeps grading.

flows.label: run-job
flows.summary: The run-job command drives a whole job directory; the web UI never grades in-process.

flows.label: one grade per exam
flows.summary: Builds `python -m autograder grade --exam ... --resume` per exam, tees stdout to grade.log and regex-scrapes stage names into state.json. stop/pause sentinel files can terminate a hung model call safely.

flows.label: load + mask pages
flows.summary: Pages rendered once per exam; instructor red ink masked before any model call.

flows.label: _get_key
flows.summary: Parse, deterministically validate, repair and cache the answer key once per package.

flows.label: key parse (legacy direct)
flows.summary: parse_answer_key runs on the legacy VisionBackend — local/mock only; the direct-cloud guard refuses anything else before the pipeline starts.

flows.label: survey / variant / alignment
flows.summary: Whole-doc survey, sheet close-read, cover-marker version decision, then alignment resolution (operator override > cached model mapping > derived > identity).

flows.label: survey & variant calls (legacy direct)
flows.summary: Survey, close-read and variant detection are legacy-path model calls on the direct backend.

flows.label: preflight + packs once per package
flows.summary: gate_package stops the batch on structural defects before any student is graded; grading packs are built once per package fingerprint and reused for every student.

flows.label: discovery on injected gateway
flows.summary: Package discovery receives the gateway as a parameter — invisible to import graphs.

flows.label: extract_exam
flows.summary: Per-question extraction; transcribe_explanations=False in reliability mode, then _enforce_deferred structurally strips transcriptions.

flows.label: banded-VLM fallback (legacy direct)
flows.summary: The VLM reads answer rows only when the deterministic grid analysis cannot; model disambiguation proposals are advisory-only.

flows.label: set_mc_resolver(chain)
flows.summary: Installed only when --models-config is present; the chain closes over runtime.gateway with cloud MC off by default.

flows.label: set_grading_policies
flows.summary: Process-global policy gate for the judge, installed alongside the MC resolver.

flows.label: multi-mark rows
flows.summary: Only multi-mark rows consult the injected resolver; no chain installed means ambiguous + review, never a guess.

flows.label: local-first MC resolve
flows.summary: resolve_row stops at the local step unless cloud MC is explicitly allowed — and the production boundary would refuse the cloud step anyway.

flows.label: judge_all + grade_exam
flows.summary: Legacy/shadow judging, then deterministic scoring for every mode.

flows.label: legacy judge call (legacy direct)
flows.summary: One judge model call per question on the direct backend.

flows.label: run_reliability_judging
flows.summary: The one call site injects gateway, RAG attach, lazy-OCR fn, evidence crops and the trace store. Reliability output becomes authoritative only in reliability mode; shadow failures are swallowed and never touch the legacy grade.

flows.label: lazy OCR per item
flows.summary: Explanation transcription happens only after the policy gate proves the item needs it.

flows.label: ocr_primary
flows.summary: Deferred transcriptions go through the gateway OCR route — the one task class allowed to leave the machine.

flows.label: primary grade + escalations
flows.summary: escalate_grade handles primary grading, validation, optional RAG retry and the escalation grader; escalate_ocr verifies suspicious transcriptions.

flows.label: verifier & grader calls
flows.summary: All escalation model work runs on the injected gateway.

flows.label: rag_attach on uncertainty
flows.summary: RAG context attaches only under RAG_ON_UNCERTAIN / RAG_ON_ESCALATION policies.

flows.label: RAG embeddings (local)
flows.summary: Course index embeddings via local Ollama /api/embed — the only non-LLM network call in the package.

flows.label: evaluations become grades
flows.summary: In reliability mode the route's evaluations are scored as authoritative; in shadow mode they only feed shadow_comparison.json.

flows.label: stage artifacts per exam
flows.summary: answer_key, survey, alignment, extraction, decisions.jsonl, result.json, report.md and per-stage resume fingerprints, rewritten as stages complete.

flows.label: job.json + state.json
flows.summary: Atomic writes after every exam transition; the UI's live progress reads this file, not the process.

flows.label: reads state & results; stages uploads
flows.summary: Screens render from state.json/result.json; uploads staged then moved into the job with anonymized names.

flows.label: queue built from artifacts
flows.summary: Review items are rebuilt from persisted result.json + extraction.json — the queue needs no live pipeline.

flows.label: review & results screens
flows.summary: The Streamlit review screen renders the queue backend; results screen shows resolution history.

flows.label: typed queue, anomalies first
flows.summary: 14 reason codes in 5 priority tiers; batch anomaly warnings precede per-item review because one systemic cause explains many flags.

flows.label: resolutions (display-only)
flows.summary: Decisions land in review_resolutions.json; apply-to-all is restricted to variant/layout and audited. Verified gap: nothing re-applies resolutions to grades on resume.

flows.label: setup_from_config
flows.summary: Runs only when --models-config is given; without it the legacy pipeline runs unhooked. Reliability and shadow modes refuse to start without it.

flows.label: builds the runtime
flows.summary: Gateway + request cache + usage ledger + budget manager constructed from models.toml in one place.

flows.label: backend_for (lazy, memoised)
flows.summary: Routes resolve to concrete backends via the single create_backend selection site.

flows.label: cache + ledger + budget
flows.summary: Cache hit returns without provider contact (still ledgered); every provider response books one ledger row; predicted cost is budget-checked before spend.

flows.label: estimates & spend views
flows.summary: Forward estimates and read-only ledger summaries power the cost panels; the two are never mixed.

flows.label: chat completions
flows.summary: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions and native Ollama /api/chat.

flows.label: OpenRouter (OCR-only in production)
flows.summary: Three boundary layers stand in front of this edge: task allowlist {ocr_primary, ocr_verify}, exact approved system prompts, and payload inspection for grading context.

flows.label: own gateway, own budget
flows.summary: The benchmark builds its own gateway with a campaign state root and ceiling — and is the only construction site that can set execution_mode=research (--research), the sole boundary bypass; live remote runs are refused without it.

notes: Two model paths coexist: legacy stages (key parse, survey/variant, extraction fallback, legacy judge) call VisionBackend.parse directly and are locked to local/mock by guard_direct_cloud_backend; everything reliability-side goes through ModelGateway.call and its cloud boundary.

--grading-mode gates the judging lane: legacy (default) and shadow run judge_all; reliability and shadow run the reliability route; shadow failures are swallowed (cli.py:967-971) and shadow scores never reach result.json.

Deliberately off-map: shared foundations (schema, strictschema, prompts, signals, metrics, dataset, reuse, eligibility, cloudcheck) and unwired research modules (provenance, canary — no runtime importer). The labeling app (separate ground-truth system on the other PC) enters only via `bench import-final-labels`.

Verified gap worth knowing: human review resolutions are recorded but display-only — no pipeline path re-applies them on resume (reviewui.py:6-10; the class docstring at reviewui.py:212 claims otherwise and appears wrong).
